title: An aggregate cap is written in prose but nothing enforces it
content:
**Side A — the written ceiling.** The instance documents state a **$5 million combined** cap across JTRSY and BUIDL.

**Side B — the enforced limits.** Each instance carries its own independent 5,000,000 USDS inflow rate limit. Nothing ties them together, so filling both is fully compliant with every on-chain constraint while breaching the written ceiling by 2x.

What makes this notable rather than a mere gap is that the same Artifact demonstrates the fix: a Diamond PAU instance uses an aggregate normalized RateLimitID precisely to bind several venues under one shared budget. The capability exists and simply was not applied here.

The same pattern appears in reverse elsewhere — instances declaring "Maximum Exposure 0 USD" in prose beside live enforced deposit budgets — suggesting prose limits and enforced limits are maintained independently.

**To resolve:** either bind the two instances under one aggregate rate limit, or correct the prose to match what is enforced.
description: JTRSY and BUIDL share a stated $5 million combined ceiling while each carries an independent 5,000,000 USDS inflow limit — filling both satisfies every enforced constraint at $10 million.
